headline: Akamai shares rose about 7.5% on 9 October as investors weighed the $11.6 billion, seven-year cloud deal it signed with Anthropic last month.
score_reason: The deal is from 24 Sep; today's news is a share-price move with no new terms, so lowered 6 to 4.
importance_line: No new deal terms appeared; the news is investors' reaction, which matters to Akamai shareholders and shows how a large AI computing contract can lift a smaller cloud company, while some analysts question the return on the heavy spending it needs.
summary: TradingKey reports that Akamai's stock rose 7.53% on 9 October 2026, as investors focused on the seven-year, $11.6 billion cloud computing agreement with Anthropic that the company announced on 24 September 2026. The report adds that analysts question the return on the deal, which requires about $5.5 billion in capital spending for Akamai, including $1.7 billion in 2026, and weighs on its free cash flow.
notes: Original TipRanks page blocked (403); text read on TradingKey, which covers the same share move. Source changed from TipRanks to TradingKey for that reason.
